content.json:
# Azure VM and Storage pricing exposure
**Report revision 1.2 - Changes beginning February 1, 2027**

This Workbook identifies deployed resources potentially exposed to the announced Azure VM and Storage price changes. **Inventory exposure, not a cost forecast. Azure public cloud only.** Other clouds return no inventory by design.

### Announced changes
- **Legacy VMs:** approximately **25%** for Bv1, D, Ds, F, Fs, G, Gs, Ls, NP, HC, Av2, Amv2, Dv2, Dsv2, Fsv2 and Lsv2, across public-cloud regions.
- **Regional VMs and Storage:** West Europe **9%**, North Europe **17%**, France Central/South **11%**, Norway East/West **9%**, Southeast Asia **8%**.
- Legacy VM and regional VM increases **do not stack**. Dsv7, Ddsv7, Dlsv7, Dldsv7, Esv7 and Edsv7 are excluded from the regional VM change. Separately billed disks/storage may still be affected.

### Using the two inventory tables
Select subscriptions, then resource groups. Click a VM or storage resource name to open its Azure portal overview; the increase percentage appears immediately after the name.

**All deployed** includes stopped/deallocated VMs and scale-set models. **Reported running VMs only** includes VMs whose Resource Graph power state reports running; unknown states are not proof of running or stopped. Scale-set model capacity is configured capacity, not a verified running count; do not add it to member VM counts. **The compute-state filter does not filter storage.** Include the resource groups containing storage accounts/disks to see regional storage exposure.

### Interpreting storage and financial impact
- **Included service/SKU:** a product explicitly included in the announced regional change; not a claim that every associated meter or covered reservation increases.
- **Candidate - verify service/meter:** a storage account that can host affected services. Account kind/SKU alone cannot prove affected usage; included and excluded services may share an account.
- **Review:** inclusion or metadata needs confirmation. **0 = review**, not a confirmed zero increase. Snapshot inclusion is unconfirmed. Consult each row's assessment for exclusions and qualifications.

Existing VM reservations retain purchase pricing through their contracted term. Actual impact depends on billable usage, agreement terms, discounts, commitments and updated meter prices. Resource Graph is eventually consistent and limited to resources the viewer can read. Tables and pickers can return at most **1,000 rows per query**; narrow the selected scope for larger inventories.

parameters.name: ResourceGroups
parameters.label: Resource groups
parameters.query:
ResourceContainers
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions/resourcegroups'
| project value = tolower(id), label = strcat(name, ' (', subscriptionId, ')')
| order by label asc

content.title: VM and scale-set model inventory - legacy ~25% and regional changes
content.query:
__COMPUTE_BASE__
| project id, name, ratePercent, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, resourceKind, vmSize, legacySeries, powerState, reportedModelCapacity, changeCategory, assessment
| order by changeCategory asc, id asc
content.noDataMessage: No impacted VMs in the selected subscriptions/resource groups and compute state. Select All deployed to include stopped, deallocated and unknown-state VMs.

labelSettings.label: VM / scale-set name (open in Azure portal)

content.title: Regional Storage inventory - included products, candidates and unconfirmed resources
content.query:
__STORAGE_BASE__
| project id, name, ratePercent, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, resourceType, accountKind, skuName, shareTier, service, classification, regionalRate, assessment
| order by classification asc, id asc
content.noDataMessage: No regional storage resources in the selected subscriptions/resource groups. Include groups containing storage accounts or managed disks. Storage is independent of the compute-state filter; legacy-region OS disks outside the seven regions are intentionally absent.

variables.$fxv#2:
Resources
| where __PUBLIC_CLOUD__
| where type in~ ('microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets')
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroups}) or tolower(strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup)) in ({ResourceGroups})
| extend resourceKind = iff(type =~ 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines', 'VM', 'VM scale-set model')
| extend vmSize = tolower(iff(resourceKind == 'VM', tostring(properties.hardwareProfile.vmSize), tostring(sku.name)))
| extend legacySeries = case(__LEGACY_CASE__, '')
| extend regionalRate = case(__REGION_CASE__, 0)
| extend isRegionalExcluded = vmSize matches regex @'__REGIONAL_EXCLUDED_PATTERN__'
| extend powerState = iff(resourceKind == 'VM', tolower(tostring(properties.extended.instanceView.powerState.code)), '')
| extend powerState = iff(isempty(powerState), 'unknown / not exposed', powerState)
| where '{ComputeState}' == 'AllDeployed' or (resourceKind == 'VM' and powerState == 'powerstate/running')
| extend changeCategory = case(
    isnotempty(legacySeries), 'Legacy VM - approximately 25%',
    isempty(vmSize), 'Review - VM size not exposed',
    regionalRate > 0 and not(isRegionalExcluded), 'Regional VM',
    'Excluded')
| where changeCategory != 'Excluded'
| extend ratePercent = case(isnotempty(legacySeries), __LEGACY_PERCENT__, isempty(vmSize), 0, regionalRate)
| extend reportedModelCapacity = iff(resourceKind == 'VM scale-set model', tostring(sku.capacity), 'n/a')
| extend assessment = case(
    isempty(vmSize), 'Review model and instance SKUs; rate cannot be determined from this resource.',
    isnotempty(legacySeries), 'Approximate list-rate increase; no additional regional VM increase. Check commitment and agreement coverage.',
    'In scope based on the announced exclusions; confirm billable SKU and agreement. Not a billed-cost calculation.')
variables.$fxv#3:
Resources
| where __PUBLIC_CLOUD__
| where type in~ (
    'microsoft.compute/disks',
    'microsoft.compute/snapshots',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts',
    'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/fileservices/shares',
    'microsoft.storagesync/storagesyncservices',
    'microsoft.elasticsan/elasticsans',
    'microsoft.netapp/netappaccounts/capacitypools/volumes')
| where '*' in ({ResourceGroups}) or tolower(strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId, '/resourceGroups/', resourceGroup)) in ({ResourceGroups})
| extend regionalRate = case(__REGION_CASE__, 0)
| where regionalRate > 0
| extend resourceType = tolower(type), accountKind = tolower(kind), skuName = tolower(tostring(sku.name)), shareTier = tolower(tostring(properties.accessTier))
| extend diskService = case(__DISK_CASE__, '')
| extend service = case(
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isnotempty(diskService), diskService,
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/disks', 'Managed disk - unrecognized SKU',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'Snapshot - inclusion unconfirmed',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.elasticsan/elasticsans', 'Azure Elastic SAN',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.netapp/netappaccounts/capacitypools/volumes', 'Azure NetApp Files',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storagesync/storagesyncservices', 'File Sync',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/fileservices/shares', 'Azure Files share',
    accountKind == 'filestorage', 'Premium Files / Files Provisioned v2 - verify billing model',
    accountKind == 'blockblobstorage', 'Premium Block Blob / ADLS Gen2',
    accountKind == 'blobstorage', 'Blob Storage',
    accountKind == 'storagev2', 'GPv2 - Blob v2 / ADLS Gen2 / Page Blob v2 / eligible Files',
    accountKind == 'storage', 'Legacy account - check Premium Page Blob versus excluded services',
    'Storage account - unrecognized kind')
| extend classification = case(
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'Review - inclusion unconfirmed',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isempty(diskService), 'Review - SKU unrecognized',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/fileservices/shares' and shareTier == 'transactionoptimized', 'Excluded',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/fileservices/shares' and shareTier !in ('premium', 'hot', 'cool'), 'Review - share tier not exposed',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'Candidate - verify service/meter',
    'Included service/SKU')
| where classification != 'Excluded'
| extend assessment = case(
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/snapshots', 'Do not assume snapshot meters inherit disk pricing; request meter-level confirmation.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/disks' and isempty(diskService), 'Check SKU against updated price sheet; no definite inclusion inferred.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.compute/disks', 'This disk product is included in the announced regional change. Verify reservation/contract and exact billed meters.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts/fileservices/shares', 'Transaction-Optimized is excluded. Confirm tier, billing model and meters; parent account may also appear.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts', 'Account is a candidate, not an all-meter increase. Excluded: General Block Blob (not v2), Standard Page Blob (not v2), Transaction-Optimized Files, Queues/Queues v2, Tables, Blob Features, Change Feed, Storage Bandwidth, Storage Actions and Storage Discovery.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.netapp/netappaccounts/capacitypools/volumes', 'Azure NetApp Files is included; Cross Region Replication SKU is excluded. Resource count is not a meter count.',
    resourceType == 'microsoft.storagesync/storagesyncservices', 'File Sync is included. This is a service container, not a count of billable servers.',
    'Azure Elastic SAN is included in the announced regional change; confirm billed meters and commercial coverage.')
| extend ratePercent = iff(classification startswith 'Review', 0, regionalRate)
variables.legacyCases: [join(map(variables('rules').legacyVmSeries, lambda('series', format('vmSize matches regex @''{0}'', ''{1}''', lambdaVariables('series').pattern, lambdaVariables('series').name))), ', ')]
variables.workbookContent: [union(variables('definition'), createObject('items', map(variables('definition').items, lambda('item', if(equals(lambdaVariables('item').type, 3), union(lambdaVariables('item'), createObject('content', union(lambdaVariables('item').content, createObject('query', replace(replace(lambdaVariables('item').content.query, '__COMPUTE_BASE__', variables('computeQuery')), '__STORAGE_BASE__', variables('storageQuery')))))), lambdaVariables('item'))))))]
